hero.title: Deals that start from what a nation’s people need
hero.lead: Perfect Nations designs a blueprint for every nation: what it owns, what its people need, and the instrument that closes each gap. Funders receive the deals that come out of that work, checked and ready to price.
hero.living_line: The Living Line: the basic standard of living every citizen should stand above: food, water, shelter, energy, education, health and livelihood.

items.name: The deal pipeline
items.line: Each deal names the nation, the gap it closes, the instrument and the size, taken from the nation’s blueprint.

items.name: Match of the week
items.line: Every week, State of Nations pairs one gap in one nation with the instrument and the kind of funder that fit it.

items.name: Introductions
items.line: When a nation and a funder fit, Perfect Nations makes the introduction, on terms agreed in writing before any name is shared.

method.title: Four steps, the same for every nation

steps.name: The Ledger
steps.line: What the nation owns: land, water, coast, forest, energy, minerals, institutions and people.

steps.name: The Living Line
steps.line: What each of the seven standards costs per citizen, and where the nation falls short.

steps.name: The Design
steps.line: Which asset carries which standard, and in what order.

steps.name: The Capital
steps.line: The instrument and the funder that close each gap, with a real deal as proof.
